eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following areas: Beauregard, LA; at 7:11 PM on AUG 16, 2023 Effective until 7:11 PM AUG 17, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Beauregard Parish Sheriff's Office can report that the fires on Leith Ln. and Hauser Rd has been contained.  There is still some burning but again it has been contained.  We will have patrol units throughout the night passing through the area to keep watch to make sure it remains contained.  We also ask you to remind vigilant and monitor as well and report if it does not remain contained.  Thank you for your patience and help in this matter. Please remain vigilant in monitoring.
